items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I don't know how many records I made with Vic Dickerson, I just -- for a Blue Note Vic Dickerson here

ctx.x: You know, not Tom Collins, John Collins. Okay, on the other side was lover. These are -- here's another Musicraft. 'Gentleman Friend' with Jimmy Jones and Sarah Vaughan, you know. Okay. I don't know how many records I made with Vic Dickerson, I just -- for a Blue Note Vic Dickerson here, 'Lyon's Den'; Bill Doggett, John Collins and Joe Jones. I don't know. And Vic Dickerson. Here are the things that I made with Duke, and Wild Bill. Joe Jones, the drummer again.
